detected_defects.root_cause: The driver has its muted property set to true.
detected_defects.description: The driver for the left eye blink shape key is currently muted, preventing the control from affecting the mesh.

detected_defects.root_cause: Constraint applied to the wrong transformation channel or axis mismatch between the bone's limit constraint and the driver's variable configuration.
detected_defects.description: The LIMIT_LOCATION constraint on browUp_L restricts movement along the Z-axis with max 0.25, but bone drivers depend on LOC_X, rendering the location limit ineffective for controlling the driver input correctly.

suggested_repairs: Align the LIMIT_LOCATION constraint axis to match the transform type used by the bone's driver (change the constrained axis to X or update the driver variable to read LOC_Z).

detected_defects.root_cause: The driver variables were incorrectly mapped during rig setup, swapping the left and right controls.
detected_defects.description: The driver for shape key mouthSmile_L is controlled by bone mouthSmile_R, and vice versa for mouthSmile_R.

suggested_repairs: Reassign the driver variable for FaceMesh:key_blocks["mouthSmile_L"].value to target pose.bones["mouthSmile_L"]["value"] instead of mouthSmile_R.
Reassign the driver variable for FaceMesh:key_blocks["mouthSmile_R"].value to target pose.bones["mouthSmile_R"]["value"] instead of mouthSmile_L.

detected_defects.root_cause: The shape key maximum limit was manually modified or incorrectly generated during shape key creation without adjusting the driver or bone limits accordingly.
detected_defects.description: The shape key slider_max for mouthFunnel is set to 2.0, whereas standard shape key ranges are typically bounded between 0.0 and 1.0, which may lead to unexpected deformation scaling when fully driven.

suggested_repairs: Reset the slider_max property of the mouthFunnel shape key back to 1.0 or adjust the corresponding driver expression to correctly handle values up to 2.0.

detected_defects.root_cause: Asymmetric constraint configuration or accidental adjustment during rigging.
detected_defects.description: The LIMIT_LOCATION constraint 'Brow Range' on bone browUp_L has an influence of 0.2, whereas the corresponding right-side bone browUp_R has an influence of 1.0.

suggested_repairs: Set the influence of the 'Brow Range' constraint on bone browUp_L to 1.0 to match browUp_R and restore symmetry.

detected_defects.description: No defects observed in the provided baseline tool outputs and inventory.

detected_defects.root_cause: Driver variable configuration error during rig setup.
detected_defects.description: The driver for the mouthFunnel shape key is incorrectly targeted to the eyeBlink_R bone instead of the mouthFunnel bone.

suggested_repairs: Open the driver for FaceMesh key_blocks["mouthFunnel"].value and update its variable target from pose.bones["eyeBlink_R"] to pose.bones["mouthFunnel"].

detected_defects.root_cause: The limit location constraint restricts bone movement to a maximum of 0.25 units, which may restrict the associated shape key range or cause sudden clamping.
detected_defects.description: The LIMIT_LOCATION constraint on browUp_L restricts translation to max_z: 0.25, but drivers evaluate bone location in world space or specific transform spaces where translation ranges might exceed or conflict with expected shape key ranges [0.0, 1.0].

suggested_repairs: Adjust the LIMIT_LOCATION constraint maximum values on brow bones to match the expected driver input range or rescale the driver expression.

detected_defects.root_cause: Constraint was configured for Z-axis translation while driver reads X-axis translation, making the limit ineffective.
detected_defects.description: The LIMIT_LOCATION constraint on bone browUp_L restricts movement on the Z axis with a maximum of 0.25, but the driver relies on LOC_X.

detected_defects.root_cause: Constraint was configured for Z-axis translation while driver reads X-axis translation, making the limit ineffective.
detected_defects.description: The LIMIT_LOCATION constraint on bone browUp_R restricts movement on the Z axis with a maximum of 0.25, but the driver relies on LOC_X.

suggested_repairs: Update the LIMIT_LOCATION constraint settings on browUp_L and browUp_R to target the X-axis (use_max_x / max_x) instead of the Z-axis, or change the driver variables to read the Z location.

detected_defects.root_cause: The driver was accidentally muted during setup or debugging.
detected_defects.description: The driver for the right brow shape key (FaceMesh:key_blocks["browUp_R"].value) is muted, preventing the control from affecting the mesh.

detected_defects.root_cause: Constraint influence was zeroed out during rig configuration.
detected_defects.description: The LIMIT_LOCATION constraint 'Brow Range' on bone 'browUp_R' has an influence of 0.0.

suggested_repairs: Set the influence of the 'Brow Range' constraint on bone 'browUp_R' to 1.0.
